question.question_text: How can you get to the living room from the kitchen?

answer_options.text: Walk forward and turn left. Walk forward until the staircase and then turn left into the living room.
Exit the kitchen and turn right. Walk until the end of the hallway and turn right into the living room.
Walk forward and turn left. Walk forward and take the first entrance on the left into the living room.
There is a door to the the living room inside the kitchen.
There is a door to the living room inside the kitchen on the opposite side of the dining table.
